top_choice_rationale: P001 is a mature, well-confirmed discovery chain, from proglucagon processing and the incretin effect through identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide and its human physiology to therapies with confirmed glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal benefit. The allocation to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov, with a citation on the physiology and the active form of the hormone, is defensible and no member disputes maturity, so an award is clearly preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; past nuclear-receptor co-authorship with Ronald Evans and co-authored works with Per Svenningsson and Abdel El Manira do not involve the credited laureates
